title: Kinetic energy expression
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be correctly expressed as k*q^2/(2a) or an equivalent simplified form.

title: Period expression
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be correctly expressed as T = (2πm/q) * sqrt(b^3/(2km + B^2 b^3)) or an equivalent simplified form.

title: Force balance reasoning
description: Important: The solution must apply Newton's second law for circular motion, balancing Coulomb force with centripetal force for part (1).

title: Magnetic force inclusion
description: Important: For part (2), the solution must correctly incorporate the Lorentz force (Bqv) into the force balance equations for both charges, accounting for opposite directions.

title: Center of mass constraint
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply the geometric constraint that the distances from the center of rotation to each charge sum to the separation (r1+r2=a or R1+R2=b).

title: Angular velocity relation
description: Important: The solution must correctly relate the period T to the angular velocity ω via T = 2π/ω.

title: Sign error in Lorentz force
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the signs for the magnetic force terms in the two force equations for part (2) are the same, rather than opposite for opposite charges.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: The final expressions should have correct dimensional units for energy (Joules) and period (seconds).
